selection.reason: The rear-position, stop and reversing lamps require photometric, emitted-colour, marking and applicable construction compliance under this consolidated light-signalling regulation.
The integrated PMMA prism retro-reflector must satisfy the applicable retro-reflective performance, colour, durability and marking requirements of this consolidated regulation.
Installation on an M1 passenger car must meet the applicable requirements for lamp and reflector number, positioning, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical operation.
The electrically operated LED assembly must meet applicable electromagnetic-compatibility requirements, including emissions and immunity relevant to its signalling functions.
The accessible exterior surfaces and edges of the lamp lens and housing must comply with the applicable external-projection requirements for M1 vehicles.
The rear lamp's design and integration must preserve the required lighting and signalling operation and visibility following the prescribed low-speed rear-impact tests.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): Separate LED light-source requirements apply if the lamp uses standardized LED sources listed in Annex 1, but the specified PCB modules do not establish that condition.
Its rear-position and stop-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its reversing-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into UN R150, which is selected instead.
Its scope expressly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices, so the PMMA outer lens is not safety glazing under this regulation.

Its stop-lamp-related provisions govern generation of the braking signal by the braking system, which this lamp is not specified to perform; lamp operation and electrical installation are addressed by UN R148 and UN R48.
